note: Models the setup script offers for claude-mnemonic's optional local LLM backend. 'status' is what we know from comparing them on real turns (see issue #26); nothing is recommended until a model passes that comparison. Sizes are approximate downloads.

models.name: gemma3:12b
models.notes: Likely the best of the shortlist at faithful summaries of long input; the largest.

models.name: granite3.3:8b
models.notes: Built for extraction and summarisation; permissive licence.

models.name: llama3.1:8b
models.notes: Same family as llama3.2, so it shows how much of the failure was model size.

models.name: llama3.2:3b
models.notes: Tested as a summarizer on real turns with the current prompt: generic and sometimes wrong. Fine for nothing that needs facts.
